description_for_human: Search your subcontractor roster and update bid status from Copilot.

functions.name: searchSubcontractors
functions.description: Search the user's CRM for subcontractors that match a trade and project location. ALWAYS call this BEFORE running a web search — these are the user's known, previously-vetted subs. Required: trade. Recommended: state and city. Combine with radius_miles to filter by service area. Returns up to 100 rows.

functions.name: getSubcontractor
functions.description: Fetch a single subcontractor by id when the user asks for details, the contact card, or the full notes for a specific company already returned by searchSubcontractors.

functions.name: updateBidStatus
functions.description: Update a subcontractor's bid status, bid amount, and/or notes. Call this when the user says things like 'mark all as bid sent', 'set the awarded sub to ABC Plumbing for $42,500', or 'add a note that they declined'. Do NOT call this on a row whose id you only inferred — only on ids returned by searchSubcontractors or getSubcontractor.
